title: When the Harvest Breaks
author: J. M. Underhill
blurb: Isandro Blackwood, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
